suno_prompt.style: A slow counting motif carries the whole track: soft plucked upright bass and muted kalimba repeat a patient four-note figure, like someone quietly counting. Bowed vibraphone and glass harmonica shimmer above it, warm and metallic, like gold catching light in dark stone. Dry, intimate, close-mic'd, a little room tone. Halfway, a low flugelhorn plays one long warm phrase. The ending opens into a full, sunlit major chord with soft strings and a brushed timpani swell, then stops cleanly on the downbeat. No piano, no drones, no choir, no vocals, no trap drums, no risers.
